blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Authorities intercepted 20 pigs unloaded from a boat along the coast of Barangay Sibalat in Magsaysay town in Occidental Mindoro on Sunday, after learning that the animals came from another province and lacked the required documents, the municipal agriculture office said. Concerned residents reported the suspected unauthorized shipment, prompting an inspection by the Magsaysay municipal government’s African swine fever (ASF) task force, the Provincial Veterinary Office, the Magsaysay Municipal Police Station and the Sibalat barangay council, according to a statement from the Magsaysay Municipal Agriculture Office.
